title: Closing Balance on a Cancelled HomeFlood Account
content:
**Calculation.** The closing payment on a cancelled HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy is the balance the account shows: every premium item charged and every refund paid on the policy, less every payment received and every credit given. It is rounded to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

| Adds to the balance | Takes from the balance |
|---|---|
| premium items charged (term premium, policy fee, installment fees, endorsement premium) | payments received |
| refunds paid out | credits given (cancellation, endorsement and re-rate credits) |

The balance runs across every term of the policy, not only the term it settles.

**Rounding.** Rounding takes the nearest cent; an amount lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the even cent.


## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| charged | 1,480.00 |
| refunds paid | 0.00 |
| payments received | 820.00 |
| credits given | 410.00 |

The closing payment is 1,480.00 less 820.00 less 410.00, that is 250.00.
